decision.explanation: The question 'When was Stanley F.C. established?' refers to Accrington Stanley F.C., which has two distinct entities: the original club and the current club. Source D1S4 states the current club was formed in 1968 and the original in 1891. Source D3S4 states the current club was formed in 1975 and the original in 1891. Source D4S3/D4S6 confirms the original club was established in 1891. Since the sources provide conflicting dates for the 'current' club (1968 vs 1975), both represent valid answers derived from the provided text for the respective entity interpretations. All three dates (1891, 1968, 1975) are retained as they correspond to distinct referents or conflicting source assertions regarding the establishment of the club.
